name: Belle

attribution.title: Belle - reconstruction from photographs

attribution.modifications: Figures reconstructed (TripoSR single-view) from Wikimedia Commons photographs: "2020 Belle (Els Rijerse) (1).jpg" by Ceescamel (CC BY-SA 4.0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:2020_Belle_(Els_Rijerse)_(1).jpg). Decimated to about 6,000 triangles per figure in the kit's material, no photo colour; plinth, pier and setting are the original low-poly kit model.
